caption: The drawing depicts a single, symmetrical, urn-shaped object centered within a rectangular border on a plain background. The object is a vase or goblet with a wide, flared rim, a rounded, bulbous body, and a narrow stem that expands outward to form a broad, rounded base. The color of the object is a uniform, muted beige or light golden hue, with smooth gradations suggesting shading and highlighting to indicate volume and curvature. The background is otherwise unadorned, remaining a blank, light parchment color. In the lower right corner, the name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in small, neat script.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
